comment: The module is monophonic. The six sets hold sixteen samples each, built into the plugin as raw data, Drums.cpp:3-98. The pitch knob is used as a power of two on the read speed, Drums.cpp:242 and DrumSampler.hpp:101, so it changes length along with pitch. The decay knob is squared before it is mapped onto 4.5ms to 4 seconds, Drums.cpp:255, which puts more of the travel at the short end. The output is the sample times the envelope times the gain times three, Drums.cpp:261.
